payload.title: File:Streamers in Flight.jpg
payload.description_html: The male Asian Paradise Flycatcher is celebrated for its spectacular ribbon-like tail feathers. Captured in flight, this image highlights the flowing elegance of the species and the rich forest habitat of Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park that supports it.
